name: Algae Pond
description:
Sustainability. It's not the name of the game... but it could be!

If you've ever wanted to generate many chemicals from a single source, you've probably looked at Oil or Benzene. However, there's also the Algae Farm.

Each tier, starting from ULV (at 50s per batch) through IV (25s per batch), reduces the time it takes to produce Algae by about 5 seconds, and then beyond that each tier will cut the duration in half. The production time can also randomly double or triple, but this happens relatively rarely.

Each tier increase also adds to the amount of Algae you get in a single cycle, as well as the type of Algae produced. Each cycle gives out an exact amount as well as a bonus amount 10% of the time. The Algae Farm also accepts Compost, which you can make from the algae itself, to boost the multi's tier by one. This might be expensive at the start, but it's heavily recommended in most cases. You can get regular Algae and Green Algae starting at ULV; Brown Algae starts appearing at HV, Golden-Brown Algae at EV, and Red Algae at IV, though higher tier algae appears in very small quantities at first.

To find out more about the exact output quantities and timings, please see the wiki: [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Algae_Farm[/url]

The Algae can be used for various chemicals like Methane, Ammonia, Sulfuric Acid, Sodium Carbonate, Ethylene, Lithium Chloride, and even some power-generating fluids. You typically need a Chemical Plant for that. In IV tier you can also combine Green Algae with Glowstone to get Glowing Coral and make Sunnarium from that. If you're curious about all the processing chains, look them up on NEI: quests to cover them are coming up, possibly with more recipes that don't need the Chemical Plant.
